mo_ta: Inside Flow, yoga thư giãn, lớp học, không gian studio. Prompt tiếng Anh cho model; ô {{…}} là chỗ điền.

prompts.prompt: Medium-wide shot, slow orbit around a {{mô tả học viên}} performing a fluid Inside Flow yoga sequence, each movement landing exactly on the beat, transitions from warrior into a flowing low lunge with arms sweeping like waves, inside {{bối cảnh studio}}. Warm golden-hour light through sheer curtains, soft haze, shallow depth of field, 35mm cinematic look, graceful and emotional. Audio: soft emotive pop music, breath sounds, bare feet on wood.
prompts.ghi_chu: Inside Flow = chuyển động khớp nhạc, nên nêu rõ 'landing on the beat'.

prompts.ten: Cận chi tiết chậm (tay, chân, hơi thở)
prompts.prompt: Extreme close-up, slow motion 60fps, of a yoga practitioner's hands gliding through the air and fingertips touching the mat, then a close-up of steady breathing, fine dust particles floating in a sunbeam, {{màu chủ đạo}} palette, macro lens, calm meditative mood. Audio: gentle ambient pad, soft inhale and exhale.
prompts.ghi_chu: Dùng làm B-roll chèn giữa các đoạn tập.

prompts.prompt: Fast dolly-in from a wide shot to a close-up of a {{mô tả học viên}} snapping into a dramatic backbend exactly on a bass drop, fabric of the outfit rippling, hair flowing, high-contrast rim light, energetic yet elegant, vertical social-media framing with the subject centered. Audio: strong beat drop, whoosh.
prompts.ghi_chu: 3 giây đầu quyết định người xem có lướt qua không.

prompts.prompt: Smooth gimbal walkthrough entering {{tên studio}}, a bright minimalist yoga studio with light wood floors, rolled mats, green plants and linen curtains moving in a breeze, morning sunlight casting long window shadows, a few students quietly preparing, calm welcoming atmosphere, architectural cinematography. Audio: birdsong outside, soft acoustic guitar.
prompts.ghi_chu: Hợp cho video giới thiệu phòng tập / Google Maps.

prompts.prompt: Editorial poster photograph of a {{mô tả học viên}} in a graceful Inside Flow pose, clean {{màu chủ đạo}} background with generous negative space at the top for a headline, soft studio lighting, magazine-quality, no text in the image.
prompts.ghi_chu: Chừa khoảng trống để tự chèn chữ bằng Canva — AI viết chữ tiếng Việt hay sai.

prompts.prompt: Emotional modern pop ballad, 92 BPM, female vocal humming without lyrics, soft piano intro building to a warm cinematic chorus with light drums at 0:20, uplifting and heartfelt, suitable for a flowing yoga choreography.
prompts.ghi_chu: Inside Flow cần nhạc có cao trào rõ để chuyển động bắt nhịp.
